title: Red Sox's Alex Cora ejected for 2nd straight game in loss
text:
Alex Cora is 0-for-2 in arguing obstruction calls with umpire Alan Porter after the Red Sox manager was ejected Monday night in the fifth inning of a 9-5 loss to the Angels, the second straight game in which Cora was tossed.
